subject: MAP cadence: staggered acceptance & contingency sync
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP cadence: staggered acceptance & contingency sync

Hi Alice and team,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Attached is a short MAP that splits acceptance into two windows (sandbox sign-off, then production acceptance) so we can reduce risk against the close date and keep momentum while legal/procurement complete review.

Key asks from your side:
- Confirm procurement/legal review ETA (hosting & data residency checks)
- Confirm whether SOC2 artifact will suffice or if you need vendor attestation (see attached SOC2-evidence-request.pdf)
- Whether a short executive intro would help unblock procurement (we can coordinate)

Proposed cadence (subject to your confirmation):
- Aug 18–22: Sandbox handoff & validation by your platform team
- Aug 25–29: Sandbox acceptance window (internal sign-off)
- Sep 15–19: Production cutover acceptance window

If that looks reasonable, I’ll update the MAP and circulate an ownership tracker. Would you be available for a 30m procurement + legal sync on Tuesday (Aug 5) at 10am PT?

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Park <alice.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Karen Lee <karen.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2025-08-02T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: staggered acceptance & contingency sync

Marissa,

Thanks for the plan — appreciate the split-window approach. A few notes from legal/procurement:
- Our legal team is doing a deeper hosting & vendor risk review this quarter; SOC2 artifact will help but we usually need evidence of recent penetration test and a signed DPA for the contracting step.
- Procurement indicates a likely delay: current internal estimate for completing vendor review is Sept 8–12. That pushes our realistic close date out to mid-September unless we can accelerate the legal review or get an interim approval for sandbox.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you provide a consolidated risk log that references the proposed mitigations so stakeholders can see the impact?
2) Will Redwood be able to provide an interim sandbox access SLA/trial extension so our teams can continue validation while legal completes review?

If you can share the updated MAP + risk log, I’ll pull procurement and legal into the Tuesday sync.

Best,

Alice Park
Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations
Acme Corp
alice.park@acmecorp.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Park <alice.park@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2025-08-03T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP cadence: staggered acceptance & contingency sync

Marissa / Jonas — looping in a quick mitigation proposal for the risk Alice outlined.

I attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx and a starter risk_log.csv. High level: we propose a three-lane approach to keep the deployment moving while legal finishes review:
- Lane A (Low friction): Sandbox access + pre-configured test data by Aug 15 (owner: SE team)
- Lane B (Medium friction): Sandbox acceptance window Aug 25–29 with a lightweight sign-off checklist (owner: Acme platform lead)
- Lane C (High friction): Production acceptance gated on DPA + penetration test evidence; target Sep 15–19 (legal/procurement dependent)

Mitigations to ask for from Acme:
- Interim sandbox approval (limited user list) — reduces dependency on full procurement clearance
- Agreement on acceptance checklist items so that sandbox sign-off can be automated where possible

Action items (owners):
- Ben: send pre-configured sandbox + run smoke tests (ETA Aug 12)
- Marissa: schedule exec intro to procurement/legal if requested
- Jonas: confirm trial extension / credit options and whether we can offer a short-term SLA guarantee to cover the interim period

I recommend we include this risk_log in the Tuesday sync packet.

Attachments: MAP_v1.1.xlsx, risk_log.csv

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Fwd: MAP cadence: staggered acceptance & contingency sync

Jonas — forwarding the thread and the updated MAP + risk log. Procurement at Acme is signaling a likely Sept 8–12 finish for the vendor review, which moves production acceptance beyond our originally targeted close.

Short summary and recommended escalation: 
- Risk: Legal/procurement gating (DPA + pen test evidence) likely pushes close ~3–5 weeks.
- Mitigation already proposed: staggered acceptance (sandbox early), limited interim SLA/trial extension, and an exec intro to procurement/legal to reduce decision latency.
- Ask for leadership: please authorize a short-term credit/trial extension option and, if acceptable, an intro from Jonas to Acme's VP of Procurement to expedite sign-off.
